result.summary: Found 3 visual issues, mostly around inconsistent navigation state and content being clipped or obscured.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights “Profile” as the active tab, but the visible page content is the home/discovery feed with restaurant recommendations.
issues.suggestion: Set the active bottom navigation item to “Home” when showing this page, or route the user to the actual Profile screen when Profile is selected.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant list content. The second card image is partially hidden behind the nav bar, making the feed feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrolling sections show partially clipped items at the right edge, including a nearly blank category chip after “Healthy” and a partially visible restaurant card in “Fastest near you.” This may look accidentally cut off.
issues.suggestion: If intentional, ensure the partial item still shows enough content to signal horizontal scrolling; otherwise adjust carousel padding or item widths so visible items are not awkwardly clipped.
